features.entry: New-session hero: click the agent-mode chip ("Standard mode" by default)
features.input: Open the mode menu and select opencode-omo
features.expect: The menu lists opencode-omo with its shipped Chinese description and the chip stages it on the blank session

features.entry: Settings -> Agent presets
features.input: Open the preset roster and read the opencode-omo card
features.expect: The card renders the preset description and the page never reports "Failed to load" (every preset row resolves, including the LSP rows)

features.entry: Blank-session mode chip
features.input: Switch the blank session from opencode-omo to Standard mode
features.expect: The composer keeps the default dsh chrome: the omo role chip is gone; switching back restores it

features.entry: opencode-omo session composer, left tool row (after the access/plan chips)
features.input: Read the role chip, open its menu, and select Prometheus - Plan Builder, then reload
features.expect: Chip accessible name is 角色：<displayName>; the menu lists exactly the five primary roles; the switch persists per session across a reload

features.entry: Role Settings primary model + composer role chip
features.input: Pin Sisyphus - Ultraworker to DeepSeek-V4-Pro in settings, then switch the composer role away and back to Sisyphus
features.expect: The composer model control reports DeepSeek-V4-Pro: the role's pinned primary is applied to the session through the model RPC

features.entry: Settings dialog nav -> opencode-omo
features.input: Open the section and read its chrome
features.expect: Heading "opencode-omo", the alignment intro paragraph, and a tablist "opencode-omo 设置页" whose single 角色设置 tab is selected (the nested settings.tab slot)

features.entry: Role Settings page
features.input: Read every role row
features.expect: All 14 catalog roles render with display name, description, omo default chain, a centered 主模型 label, and one fallback "+" control each

features.entry: Role Settings -> role row -> 主模型 dropdown
features.input: Open the dropdown, pick DeepSeek-V4-Pro, reload the page
features.expect: Menu offers 跟随当前 plus the four catalog models; the pinned model is durable across a reload and can be reset to 跟随当前

features.entry: Role Settings -> role row -> circle "+" button
features.input: Open the fallback panel, filter with the search box, add two models, then pick an already-added model
features.expect: The panel opens below the role box and stays open for repeat additions; each pick becomes a removable chip; a duplicate is refused with 该模型已在 fallback 列表中

features.entry: Role Settings -> open fallback panel
features.input: Close the panel with 取消, with Escape, and by clicking outside the role area
features.expect: No fallback is added in any of the three cases

features.entry: Role Settings -> fallback chip -> remove control
features.input: Click 移除 <model> on each chip and reload
features.expect: Chips disappear on click and stay gone after a reload

features.entry: Any accepted change on the Role Settings page
features.input: Add a fallback, then read the host's settings document ($DSH_HOME/settings.yaml); remove it and read again
features.expect: The opencode-omo-roles namespace carries the role-keyed fallback entry, and removal writes an empty list back

features.entry: Role Settings layout
features.input: Open a role's fallback panel and measure the live boxes
features.expect: Chip list and add panel stack below the role box at the row's full width without overlap; no horizontal overflow in the settings surface; the "+" control is a 28px circle; the last catalog row's panel is not sheared off by its scroll container

features.entry: opencode-omo session composer, "/" trigger
features.input: Type "/" and read the trigger menu
features.expect: handoff, hyperplan, refactor, remove-ai-slops, start-work, stop-continuation, and team-mode are all offered

features.entry: opencode-omo session composer, "/" trigger
features.input: Type "/" and read the trigger menu
features.expect: The omo skills published as user-dsh (ast-grep, coding-agent-sessions, programming, ulw-plan, ulw-research, visual-qa, ...) are discoverable

features.entry: Standard-mode session composer, "/" trigger
features.input: Type "/" in a session that is not opencode-omo
features.expect: The omo commands and skills are absent (the catalogs are preset rows, not global)

features.entry: Non-loopback (memory-mode) browser: role settings fall back to the authenticated /opencode-omo channel
features.input: POST the memory-mode client-request envelope (catalog/get) to /opencode-omo/catalog/get with the browser session cookie
features.expect: The channel answers a JSON server-response with ok:true and the role catalog. On dsh 0.1.6-alpha.1 the channel is never mounted: connection.rpc.handle() needs the caller to inject webServer, so registration throws and the request falls through to the SPA fallback (405). Pinned with test.fail() in the spec and asserted to fail by the run.

features.entry: dsh --profile web --dump-config against the installed home
features.input: Run the CLI and read the composed tree
features.expect: Exit 0; the tree contains the opencode-omo bundle row naming @royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo and the agent-presets roster row

features.entry: install.py's documented install steps (symlink package, edit profile manifest, publish preset through $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets)
features.input: Inspect the installed profile manifest and the published preset directory
features.expect: The profile lists the link: dependency and the bundle entry; $DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/opencode-omo is a real directory whose entries are symlinks into the checkout
